name: Aberford Park Playground and Sensory Play Area
description: A playground for under-8s with a multi-play unit, toddler and flat swings, roundabout and zip wire, plus a sensory play area for up to 12s with a basket swing, rotating dish, rope bridge and climbing wall, next to a skate park, restaurant and toilets.
